notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 Next Message Request service. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies selection and delivery of the next queued timestamped interaction before the requested grant, callback ordering, logical-time and retraction metadata, and the standard no-longer-retractable boundary. The undefined-GALT case observes NRG-on granting at queued LITS without a regulator advance and NRG-off holding at current logical time until a regulator resumes. These checks do not assert a universal GALT formula, provider-specific behavior, conformance, or interoperability.
